data.name: Chandrahaas
data.gender_notes: Chandrahaas is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Chandrahaas derives from the Sanskrit words 'Chandra' meaning moon and 'Haas' meaning horse. In Hindu mythology, the Moon is often depicted as riding a horse. Thus, Chandrahaas can be interpreted as 'Moon Rider'. The name Chandrahaas carries the meaning “Moon Horse” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Chandrahaas usually hope their child will grow to embody moon horse and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes a deep connection with the cycles of nature and the passage of time.
data.etymology: Chandrahaas belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Moon Horse.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Chandrahaas total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.
